items.title: Paramount puts CNN sale on table to settle 12-state antitrust suit
items.summary: Makan Delrahim made the disclosure at Politico’s California Agenda conference, according to Reuters, signaling that Paramount is willing to go beyond internal safeguards to salvage a deal that has become one of the most politically charged media mergers in years. Warner Bros. Discovery is the publicly traded parent of CNN (NASDAQ: WBD), and the merger’s fate directly determines whether Ellison’s Paramount consolidates control over both CBS News and the cable network.

items.title: Paramount Has Discussed Creating a Board to Ensure CNN’s Independence
items.summary: Paramount  in recent months has discussed creating an editorial board for CNN and other safeguards to ease concerns over its news operation’s independence, according to people familiar with the situation.  Paramount, which owns CBS News, has agreed to buy CNN parent  Warner Bros. Discovery  for $81 billion.  The internal discussions about establishing an oversight committee for news have come up as the company has planned for the deal’s closing, the people said.
